A.title: Ground truth provenance
details: Formal labels trace to ScanRefer annotation object IDs, ScanNet instance-member occupancy and axis-aligned boxes of annotated object points. The evaluator reads center_label/size_gts/gt_masks, not a model-produced reference.

Training retains native augmentation and GT box jitter; formal evaluation disables augment and augment_det. Both current arms use auxiliary_target_mode=native_gt. Predicted own/fused Mask evidence conditions the reference geometry; support_reference_box is a model prediction stage, not an evaluation target.

Formal prediction inputs do not receive GT box/mask eligibility. Training-only matched/qualified roles are created after forward and are not an inference filter. No teacher or new distillation target appears in this executed loss chain.

B.title: Native score, thresholds and denominators
details: Ranking is native last_/bbs token evidence: softmax over token logits, root/modifier/pronoun/relation evidence minus other-entity evidence. IoU is intersection / union. Strict thresholds are >0.25 and >0.50; formal denominator is all 9508 ordered rows. No accuracy denominator is derived from a model maximum, minimum or mean.

The runner actually invokes the pinned native GroundingEvaluator, asserts row-recount equality to native bbs counts, and checks the Mask IoU sum. CPU double-precision geometry recomputation covers every selected coarse/reference/final box in the two arms' six evaluation files plus both stored selected boxes in the parent formal file. All 158708 IoU computations yield zero threshold flips; largest stored-vs-CPU absolute IoU difference is 2.8997857486334766e-6.

Mask percentages and Full256 coverage are recounted from stored scalars only. Raw Mask fields and the complete 256 boxes/rank logits are not in these rows, so this review does not claim an independent native-model or all-candidate replay.

All seven evaluation receipts agree with complete raw-row counts, their file SHA256 and recomputed metrics; both complete training receipts agree with all 3723 raw updates and recorded progress/completion logs. The formal table is parent 5616/4511, control 5625/4505, support_reference 5625/4495.

The original local observer handle 40310 has an explicitly unobserved exit code. It is not used as a fabricated exit-0 witness. The recorded later observer closes the observation task using the original remote controller evidence.

D.title: Executed chain and dead-code distinction
details: controller.py invokes run_geometry_fit.py sequentially in control/train, control/formal, support_reference/train, support_reference/formal. Training uses the native criterion and actual final Hungarian assignment matches[1], matched DFL, qualified extra geometry and (support arm only) reference L1/GIoU. Both raw train logs expose these losses for every update.

observed_readback_forward hooks require refiner -> readback -> final native semantic head, with exactly one deployed final semantic-head call. All 56072 audited evaluation rows record one deployed call and zero diagnostic replay calls. The selected Query supplies both the final box and its fused Mask.

Initial/terminal/formal evaluate calls are live and their completion records match the files. Legacy run_final_quality_fit/native_final_quality helpers and their bypass diagnostic are present in the supplied bundle but are not executed by this comparison; their existence is not treated as a new result. No claimed current metric is supported only by dead code.

E.title: Data scope, seed, parameter history and claim ceiling
details: Exactly 3723 updates and 29778 unique fit row IDs per arm are present, with identical order, 3722 batches of 8 and a final batch of 2. Their ID set is disjoint from the 6887 holdout IDs and jointly covers 0..36664. This proves recorded input-ID coverage/order, not a bytewise replay of all training augmentations.

Each initial/terminal set contains 6887 rows from 106 scans and is a module holdout from the parent training domain. It is not the 9508-row, 141-scan formal development evaluation. Seed is 2027, one continuation per condition; no new Nr3D/Sr3D evaluation or repeated seeds appear.

Only 456102/10 old geometry parameters/state tensors (control) or 459180/12 (support) are trainable; the added reference layer is 3078 parameters and zero-initialized. Runtime checks/logs report unchanged parent and zero-R states and exact optimizer restoration. Current 3723 updates are independently counted; the old-state 11169->14892 history is reconciled through parent source/receipt lineage, not independently replayed from all historic checkpoints. New reference parameters receive this segment only.

Both arms fail to beat the protected 4511 strict hits: control -6, support -16; support versus control repairs 16 and damages 26, net -10. The predeclared acceptance condition is unmet. Internal reference repairs, losses or face shifts cannot establish independent-baseline gain, a causal failure mechanism, statistical stability, new distillation effectiveness or cross-dataset generalization.

Frozen parameters and same-cache preflight equivalence do not imply identical outputs across independent full forwards: formal row 6374 has different Mask scalar IoUs (same Query 138, same GT/points); neither crosses either threshold.

F.title: Evaluation type and diagnostic labels
details: Official-style ScanRefer development accuracy and all saved selected-box stages are real_gt: each is scored against the dataset object box; selected Mask is scored against dataset occupancy.

The predicted support reference is an intermediate geometric prediction, not synthetic ground truth. Full256 is a GT oracle-coverage diagnostic, and the stage transition analysis concerns the same selected Query within a model. Neither is deployed accuracy, a separate baseline improvement or evidence of new distillation/generalization.

Independent CPU verification reproduces all eight strict three-stage bit counts plus max six-face movements/GT errors and linear-interpolation quantiles. The six faces may be enumerated in a different order in the independent calculation; max absolute distances are invariant to consistent axis/sign ordering.

details: Analyzer selection sorts by strict hits first, then parent tie preference, then .25 for ties between new models. The retention wrapper consumes current SUMMARY.fit_order_exact, cpu_selected_coarse_reference_box_threshold_flip_counts and table fields, gates on actual closure/fresh terminal call/no blockers, and rechecks the prior source-review file identities.

Retention restricts root and parent to literal resolved paths, restricts each candidate to its arm/terminal.pth, validates actual fit/formal/restore receipts and full 10/12-state geometry payload/optimizer schema, and refuses a non-parent winner unless its strict metric exceeds the parent. For the current table it deletes only the two closed new candidates, preserving the parent; it does not enumerate or recursively delete general directories, archive weights, or touch PV/G/V99 paths.

New original and fast publishers consume the current wait, SUMMARY and future retention/resource schemas correctly. They require an actual terminal review result, successful cleanup/resource records, consistent best identity, unchanged history prefixes, four identical local handoffs, pinned repository heads and clean trees. This is source/schema inspection; no document, repository, remote resource or weight mutation occurred in this review.

The fast publisher is a direct inspected diff of the unchanged original. Only existing complete/ payload verification (excluding new INTAKE.json) changes from per-file SFTP byte readback to one CPU SHA256 comparison over the same local bytes. New payloads and the document retain byte readback, Git byte checks and history checks; the remote complete symlink is constrained to this closed run. This is transport optimization, not an evaluation or hash-framework addition.

The actual weight_retention.json, CLOSED_RESOURCES.json and terminal_publication.json do not exist at review time. Their future success must not be represented as already completed. The compressed collection stream and backend model identity are also not independently attested by this source review.
